name: Vercel AI Cloud
tagline: Vercel's agent stack as cloud primitives: gateway, sandbox, workflows, drives.
description: Guillermo Rauch frames the AI Cloud as old cloud pieces reborn: the AI SDK replaces the frontend framework, AI Gateway is a CDN of tokens, Sandbox is compute for code written by agents, Fluid runs long IO-bound work, Workflow makes it durable, Connect handles scoped credentials, Chat SDK reaches every platform and Drives hold the files.
